title: Exhibit exact BIT readout obstructions for a diamond and three helper splits
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

All six ordered basis choices for the prescribed ingress swap on the literal 0→2/5→125 diamond fail the clock-11 readout with other payloads fixed. Its ideal equal-grade signed delta is zero. Separately, the three optimistic helper splits remaining from 200 named representatives all fail their fixed-source middle readouts, even with the specified free later stocks. A two-world witness for helper 469 agrees at all seven supplied rows while its old input and new signal disagree.

## Task and overlap

Uses #7830 at 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15. #7881 treats rechart geometry with fixed packet forms. These two replays preserve the named route observations while allowing the specified local basis or readout changes. Compensated exterior observations are outside scope.

## Validation and credit

The diamond replay recomputes source, pulse and corruption controls. The helper verifier checked the exact bounded sample and readout rows, including wrong-signal, missing-CLEAR and corrupted-source controls, from read-only offline copies. README and archive manifests give commands, inputs, signs and counts. Thanks to the #7830 and BIT callers' contributors. OpenAI Codex assisted.

## Open next questions

Changed upstream or exterior payloads, additional paid observations and larger helper encodings remain open. No κ gain follows.
